role: produce a non-executable proposed Prism DSL JSON transformation

input.task: Remove ASCII space and ASCII hyphen only from the phone field of synthetic invoice rows; preserve every other field and character.
input.required_output: A single JSON object with keys dsl_version and steps only. The proposed operation must be remove_ascii_phone_separators on column phone.

evaluation: the local command exits before timeout
the output is non-empty UTF-8 text
the output is recorded without execution
the response is evaluated as a proposal, not evidence of model correctness
